{{Quote|Tell the transports to fall back to Obi-Wan's position. We'll cover their retreat as they escape behind the moon.|Anakin Skywalker, to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]|<ref name="CM" />}}
'''Christophsis's moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].<ref name="CM" /><ref name="FF" /> Its light-colored surface was marked by large fissures. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] task force hid behind the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] planned their next move.<ref name="CM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', released before [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|''The Clone Wars'': Season Two]], stated that Christophsis had no moon.<ref name="EA" /> Later, in [[2014]], the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 6|sixth issue]] of the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|second run]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' corrected this inaccuracy.<ref name="FF" />
